channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Scottish Government to order four ships at Ferguson Marine
item.description: The Scottish Government said today that it intends to directly award contracts for four new vessels to Ferguson Marine in a move designed to secure the long-term future of the state-owned shipyard. The post Scottish Government to order four ships at Ferguson Marine first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Ferguson Marine secures four-vessels from Scottish Government
item.description: Ferguson Marine has secured a direct award from the Scottish Government covering four new vessels, a move the yard says will provide a five-year pipeline of work and safeguard hundreds of jobs on the Clyde. The post Ferguson Marine secures four-vessels from Scottish Government first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Sweeney presses for shipbuilding finance reform
item.description: Scottish Labour MSP Paul Sweeney has urged ministers to treat the proposed four-vessel award to Ferguson Marine as a starting point for wider reform. The post Sweeney presses for shipbuilding finance reform first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: YFQ-44A tests dual autonomy stacks in flight
item.description: Anduril has announced that its YFQ-44A Collaborative Combat Aircraft has flown with two different mission autonomy software suites from separate vendors during a single sortie. The post YFQ-44A tests dual autonomy stacks in flight first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Sweeney: Award should trigger Scotland-wide shipbuilding strategy
item.description: Scottish Labour MSP Paul Sweeney has set out a detailed case for far wider reform of Scotland's commercial shipbuilding model. The post Sweeney: Award should trigger Scotland-wide shipbuilding strategy first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain deploys warship to protect against drones
item.description: The UK is deploying the Type 45 destroyer HMS Dragon and Royal Navy Wildcat helicopters to the Eastern Mediterranean. The post Britain deploys warship to protect against drones first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British F-35B downs drone in first operational kill
item.description: A British F-35B has shot down a hostile drone over Jordan, marking the first time a British F-35 has destroyed a target on operations. The post British F-35B downs drone in first operational kill first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Husband of Labour MP arrested in China spying probe
item.description: The husband of a Scottish Labour MP has been arrested as part of a counter-terrorism investigation into suspected spying linked to China. The post Husband of Labour MP arrested in China spying probe first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Redefining sovereign capability for maritime resilience
item.description: Writing in the UK Defence Journal, Ferguson Marine CEO Graeme Thomson argues the UK must broaden its definition of sovereign shipbuilding capability and provide long-term certainty to sustain skills, regional yards and industrial capacity. The post Redefining sovereign capability for maritime resilience first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Royal Navy certifying Astute for under-ice operations
item.description: The Royal Navy seeks to maintain a certified under-ice operational capability centred on its submarine force as competition in the Arctic grows. The post Royal Navy certifying Astute for under-ice operations first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
